title: FAQ's
section: The applicant is required to fill all the columns of the form and tick the box(es) on the left margin of the appropriate item where change/correction is to be done. [ What are the documents required to be furnished while submitting the form? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-collapseSix) Following documents are required to be submitted along-with the form:   * [Proof of PAN](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-of-pan) (the one currently in use - mentioned at the top of the application) if available;   * [Proof of Identity;](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-id)   * [Proof of Address;](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-id)   * [Proof of Date of Birth (for Individual and Karta of HUF)](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-id)   * [Proof in support of changes sought*, if any;](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-in-support)   * [Proof of PAN(s) surrendered, if any;](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#proof-in-surrend)  [ What documents can be submitted as proof of PAN? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-collapseSeven) Any one of the following documents can be submitted as proof of PAN:   1. Copy of PAN card   2. Copy of PAN allotment letter  No other documents are acceptable as proof of PAN.  If any proof of PAN is not available, the application will be accepted on a 'good effort' basis.  [ What documents can be submitted as proof of PAN surrendered? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-collapseEight) Any one of the following documents can be submitted as proof of PAN surrendered:   1. Copy of PAN card   2. Copy of PAN allotment letter  No other documents are acceptable as valid proof of PAN surrendered.  If any proof of PAN surrendered is not available, then application will not be accepted.  [ What documents can be submitted as proof of identity, proof of address & proof of date of birth (not applicable for foreign citizens) in case of individual applicants and HUF applicants? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-reqfornewpan.html#english-collapseNine) 1. Individual and HUF Applicants who are citizens of India and located within and outside India at the time of application for PAN:   | Proof of Identity  | Proof of Address   | Proof of date of birth  |   | --- | --- | --- |   | Indian Citizens (including those located outside India)  |   | (i) Copy of of the following documents **bearing name of the applicant** as mentioned in the application:-  | (i) Copy of of the following documents **bearing the address** mentioned in the application:-  | Copy of any of the following documents bearing the name, date, month and year of birth of the applicant as mentioned in the application:-  |   | b. Elector’s photo identity card; or  | b. Elector’s photo identity card; or  | b.
